references.text: Describes the same place where the Israelites camped at Pi-Hahiroth, in front of Baal-Zephon, as mentioned in Numbers 33:7.
Mentions Pi-Hahiroth and Baal-Zephon as the place where the Egyptians overtook the Israelites, the same location as in Numbers 33:7.
Describes the Israelites' departure from Etham, which corresponds with the departure from Etham mentioned in Numbers 33:7.
